# poweradmin_zone_metadata (Data Source)

Retrieves the values of one PowerDNS metadata kind of a zone, such as `ALLOW-AXFR-FROM`. Reading a kind that has no values is an error; use `poweradmin_zone_metadata_entries` to list the kinds a zone has. Requires Poweradmin 4.3.0+.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the values of one metadata kind of a zone
data "poweradmin_zone_metadata" "example" {
  zone_id = 10
  kind    = "ALLOW-AXFR-FROM"
}

output "axfr_allowed_from" {
  value = data.poweradmin_zone_metadata.example.values
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Metadata kind, e.g. `ALLOW-AXFR-FROM`; Poweradmin matches it case-insensitively
- `zone_id` (Number) ID of the zone

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format `zone_id/kind`
- `values` (List of String) Values of the kind, in the order the server returns them
